title: Garrett Wilson expects Jets to make playoffs, calls chances 'very realistic'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Garrett Wilson expects Jets to make playoffs, calls chances 'very realistic'
sources.description: The Jets haven't made the playoffs since 2010, but if you ask Garrett Wilson what he thinks of their chances at making it back to the postseason this year, the wide receiver not only believes they can, but expects them to.
